## PR Title Format

Use the Conventional Commits format:

```text
<type>[optional scope]: <description>
```

Examples:

```text
docs: add system architecture documentation
docs(decisions): document technology selection
feat: add reminder scheduling
fix(discord): handle failed command responses
refactor: simplify reminder service
test: add reminder service tests
build: configure project tooling
chore: update repository configuration
```

The description should be concise and describe the change. Use lowercase after the colon and omit the period.

See the [Conventional Commits specification](https://www.conventionalcommits.org/en/v1.0.0/) for the full format.
